verdict.rationale: ROS 2 ships a first-party CLI (`ros2 topic`, `ros2 node`, `ros2 param`, `ros2 bag`, service introspection) built on a DDS-based distributed graph, which by design lets a client machine subscribe to topics, echo/publish, inspect nodes/services, and record/playback data from any node in the same domain — including a remote robot — without extra tooling (ros2-docs-8,30,37,38,39,10,24,34,17,23,25,26). Topic statistics further support debugging message timing/health remotely (ros2-docs-11). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of remote log viewing/aggregation (e.g., `ros2 log`/rqt_console) and network-specific guidance for cross-machine discovery/security when debugging over untrusted networks, plus independent hands-on confirmation of remote debugging workflows.
